additional_info.subject: RE: ID0474444-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP/S5 170003609] Connector 1 currently faulted CRM:03288000215
additional_info.body:
Dear Anass,
Thank you for the information!
We already know that a reboot helps often, but on this charger this happened 2 times in a short span.
The first time was on the 10./11.01.2026 where a colleague of me was stopping by the charger and saw that the same Outlet was “red”/not working and did a restart on site. After the restart it was back on “green”/available
Now it’s the second time this has happened, and I’m beginning to think there may be something “bigger” behind this behavior of this Outlet, as this issue keeps occurring.
Could you observe this charger/outlet for a little longer or look into why this keeps coming up?
Thank you and kind regards!
Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Lara Oblak
